readings: For each invoice number in the invoice line items, compute the average `product_quantity` and (total `derived_product_cost` − total `derived_total_cost`) ÷ total `derived_total_cost`, with the totals summed over its lines. Keep only invoices whose average quantity is above the average of all the invoices' average quantities, and list the invoice number, its average quantity, that cost ratio, and how far its average quantity is above that overall average. Sort by that difference from largest to smallest (missing last), show the top 10, and don't round. Ignore missing values in averages.
queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(product_quantity) AS average_quantity,
        SUM(derived_product_cost) AS total_product_cost,
        SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_cost
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    i.average_quantity,
    (i.total_product_cost - i.total_cost) / NULLIF(i.total_cost, 0) AS cost_ratio,
    i.average_quantity - o.average_quantity AS quantity_difference
FROM invoice_averages AS i
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE i.average_quantity > o.average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
